final: SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as avg_acl_igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10
